title: Twisted Torpor
tech: Unity, Blender, Paint.net, Spacedesk, Adobe CC, VSCode, C#, DevOps
summary: A 2D and 3D ARG horror game, in development.
description: Under development. A blend of 3D and 3D ARG horror game designed in Unity and programmed in C#. The player solves small series of puzzles to defeat his foe "Torpor" who exhausts him with mental deterioration and physical exhaustion. The game is desigend as a story with alternating 2D and 3D levels to alter consciousness.
